thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: realtime-p99 EU streaming latency > SLO (p99 1.8s, threshold 1.2s) detected by pulse detector. Alert ID: alert-176123.
oncall-jamie: Acknowledged. I'm on it. @sre-ana can you grab traces + host list? I'll start customer impact check.
sre-ana: pulling traces now. initial glance: spike correlates to many concurrent streams hitting model-variant:v2a. KV cache hit rate dropped from 98% -> 72% around 1761234500.
ml-tyler: that matches a rollout we did last night — v2a has larger context and different shard behavior. Did we enable batch-size auto-growth? @infra-lee
infra-lee: checking autoscaler events and recent deploys... `kubectl get events --namespace=prod | grep 1761234` shows a burst of pod restarts on eu-serving-2 at ~1761234480.
oncall-jamie: Quick customer impact — PMs: any user-facing errors? @pm-ravi
pm-ravi: no errors reported yet, some customers on EU have slight UX lag, CS flagged 2 tickets with slow responses. Not widespread but could escalate.
sre-ana: adding links: dashboard: https://dash.internal/realtime?alert=176123 — top hosts: eu-srv-2a-03, eu-srv-2a-04. Traces show tail token generation taking ~900ms on those hosts.
ml-tyler: possible KV cache capacity mismatch + changed tokenization path in v2a. Recommend immediate mitigation: 1) pin routing to v2 (stable) for new requests, 2) disable v2a rollout (rollback flag), 3) increase prefix cache size as hotfix.
oncall-jamie: Can we flip routing quickly? infra-lee, how fast to roll back the canary and shift traffic?
infra-lee: routing change is 2 commands: `redwood route update --pool eu --model v2 --percentage 100` — should propagate within 30s-90s. Rolling back deployment also possible but routing is faster.
sre-ana: one more quick check: disk IO on eu-srv-2a-03 is high during spikes (iowait ~18%). I think it's swapping in some sharded kv segments.
ml-tyler: confirm: v2 uses larger KV segment size; we missed the quantization/eviction tweak. I'll prepare a rollback and a config to reduce segment size.
oncall-jamie: Do it. infra-lee please shift routing to v2 now, announce once done. I'll start a short watch for 10m then hand back to oncall.
infra-lee: executing now: `redwood route update --pool eu --model v2 --percentage 100` — command returned OK, rolling window 45s.
incident-bot: INFO: routing change event logged (event-id: evt-176123-01)
sre-ana: seeing immediate drop in p99 on the dashboard down to ~1.25s within 60s. KV hit rate climbing back to 95% on eu-srv-2a-*.
pm-ravi: Noted. Updating CS with: "We rerouted traffic to stable model variant; engineers are monitoring. Expecting normalization within minutes."
oncall-jamie: Great. Leaving a watch: I'll remain on this thread for 10m. If p99 stays >1.2s after 10m -> page ENG-SRE escalation. cc @sre-ana @infra-lee
sre-ana: continuing to tail logs for any pod restarts or OOMs.
ml-tyler: I'll open a follow-up PR to adjust rollout config and add a pre-check for KV size vs host memory. Link: https://git.internal/rg/model-rollouts/pulls/1234
oncall-jamie: Thanks all. Handing off to infra-lee for long-watch (30m) once the immediate 10m passes. Documenting timeline in incident tracker: https://incidents.internal/176123
infra-lee: taking long-watch. I'll escalate if any host shows IO > 10% or p99 > 1.2s.
pm-ravi: I'll bat signal CS to queue proactive outreach if any customers in the next hour report degradation.
incident-bot: Incident thread marked: triage-in-progress. :white_check_mark:"
